synthesis.assessment:
Iteration One is close to done. Five targeted fixes remain; nothing needs structural rework.

**Verdicts.** All 25 maps plus the island were seen. The result is 13 excellent, 12 good, 0 needs work, with the island good. Iter2 was 4 excellent, 20 good and 1 needs work (40002, now good). Where verifiers disagreed, the map-level verifier's verdict wins over the region verifier's, because it saw the Gameplay and Overview renders at full scale. Examples: 0, 10000, 40000, 50000, 1000002/3/4, 1010004 and 1020001 rise to excellent; 60000 drops to good because its boarding-point clause failed.

**Island.** All eight island criteria pass. The four iter2 island blockers are cleared:
- the faceted cloud collar and peak halos
- the runway comb across the forest cluster
- the broken main road (now traceable from the NW tip through the fork to Southperry and to Amherst)
- Mushroom Town not reading as a meadow pocket under a peak wall

The island now clearly evokes the classic world map. Validation is all yes, with 20/20 trails walking.

**How must_fix was chosen.** An item qualifies only if (a) a verifier criterion failed on it, or (b) two or more verifiers flagged it at medium severity at a visually central spot. In both cases the fix must also be local to one module with no layout cascade. Five items qualify, and every failed criterion maps to one of them:
1. **Southperry boarding point** (criterion fail). The code confirms the gangplank sits 0.2 m from the main mast, so the mast hides it by construction.
2. **Rope silhouette** in the shared kit. Three verifiers flagged it, and it weakens the 'moves like' half of the goal on 40001, 1020000 and 30000. The fix removes the above-lip stake and drape, not just the colour.
3. **Waterfall cliff.** Two verifiers rated it medium, and it sits at the centre of every island shot. The fix is scenery only, with no traversal impact.
4. **1000006.** Neighbour occlusion in its Gameplay frame plus the bridge read (criterion fail). The span exists, so only contrast and the visible void are needed.
5. **30000.** Its Gameplay frame exists to show the ropes; it needs reframing plus rope contrast.

**What goes to Iteration Two.** Everything else is polish or structural and is listed as deferrable: hull crags (already in DEFERRED.md), straightening the 1000006 trail (a layout cascade, and the length was accepted in R3-5), flank dressing, ridge jitter, cloud shadow lift, ribbon seams, framing polish and similar items.

**Sequencing.** Per the project rule against editing shared src/misostory/*.py while map fixers run:
1. Land the two shared edits first, mapkit._hanging_strand and world.lake, as one slot.
2. Rebuild and re-validate (floating_props, props_near_routes, ladder coverage, traversal, trail walk).
3. Then run the three map-scope fixes (60000, 1000006, 30000) in parallel.
4. Re-render the affected frames and do a single bounded re-check:
   - Southperry_60000_Gameplay
   - 40001, 1020000, 30000 and 1000006 Gameplay
   - Island_Overview_Close and Island_Hero
   - Region_MapleRoad and Region_WestAmherstForests

If that re-check passes, Iteration One meets its goal and the deferrable list becomes the Iteration Two backlog.

criteria.name: (1) Hunting grounds keep distinct compositions
criteria.evidence: Each of the 7 Gameplay frames has a different centrepiece and silhouette. 40000: a three-tier oval stepped knoll with flagstone flights, two ladders on a long soil cliff and autumn birches. 40001: an arch of grass-capped stone drums with a real voussoir void, plus a drum stair climbing to a signboard summit, set on diagonal terraces. 40002: a stone chimney (two pillars topped by red banners, discs between them) with a cream main road winding past it. 1000002: a dark moss floor below a soil cliff hung with 6 long leafy vines. 1000005: a rainbow fountain, a door-in-block mound with its portal, and a grey spire wrapped in jump discs. 1000006: floating root-ball islets with giant lily-of-the-valley over a golden, leaf-strewn dell. 1000001: a giant white birch trunk ringed by a spiral of grass ledges, with a stepped hill in front. 40000 and 40002 share the knoll by design (the classic data does too), but the 40002 Gameplay frames the chimney and road, not the knoll. No two look alike.

criteria.name: (2) Player and >= 2 mobs in frame establish scale
criteria.evidence: The player is visible in all 7 frames. Mobs are clearly visible in each: 40000 has about 7 snails and blue snails around the knoll. 40001 has about 8, including a blue snail beside the player under the arch. 40002 has red snails at about (240,670) and (1255,785) px plus blue and green snails. 1000002 has orange mushrooms plus red and blue snails. 1000005 has blue and red snails on the top-right shelf and a snail on the mound. 1000006 has a blue snail, snails and an orange mushroom. 1000001 has an orange mushroom and a red snail. build_report gameplay_frame agrees: mobs_in_frame is 6-9 per map against 2 required, player_uv inside 0.1-0.9 everywhere. Snails are now a readable size next to the player (about 0.5x player height).

criteria.name: (3) Climbs (ropes/ladders) read as climbs
criteria.evidence: Ladders and vines are unambiguous. Ladders: 40000 x2 on the meadow cliff, 40002 on the cliff at about (550,690) px and at the chimney top, 1000005 x2 (door mound, top-right shelf), 1000001 x2 at the bottom-right. Vines: 1000002's six leafy vines down the shelf face, and 1000001's three on the back cliff. Ropes read in 1000005 and 1000001, where they are longer strands with a ring at the foot. They read weakly in 40000 (east-meadow ropes at about x 1410/1530 px), 40001 (about (460,490), (265,600), (905,935) and (1615,975) px) and 40002 (the three chimney ropes at about x 810-850 px). There the 4-5 px strand and its drape over the lip make a crook or walking-stick shape that reads more like a stake than a rope. Pass overall, with a medium shared issue raised for the rope look.

criteria.name: (4) 40002's crest walk is visible and readable
criteria.evidence: In the 40002 Overview the crest is a painted cream M_Main_Road ribbon. It runs along the top terrace from the chimney (about (920,265) px) diagonally to the east portal (about (1460,610) px), then down the trail stair, with low grass-rock rim segments along its back edge. The grove no longer hides it: only a few trees overlap, around (1090-1330, 300-410) px. The Gameplay frame also shows the crest road running to the upper right, past the flagged chimney. The through-route reads as one cream road broken only at the climbs: west approach, then knoll stair, then chimney foot, then crest. Around_Knoll stays brown dirt, as the triage asked. Minor: the dense world forest right behind the crest competes with it visually.

criteria.name: (5) Dangerous Forest reads darker / more dangerous
criteria.evidence: 1000002's Gameplay uses dark moss-green turf, dark pines and teal canopies, purple toadstools, thorny dark bramble clumps (about (590,530), (1190,500) and (1720,420) px), mossy boulders and logs. Its colour key is clearly darker than all six other hunting frames, and in the 1000006 frame its dark ground sits visibly against 1000006's bright turf. It is still lit by the same strong global sun, so it reads as moody and saturated rather than gloomy. That is a low polish item.

criteria.name: (6) Renders look intentional, no broken geometry
criteria.evidence: All 8 renders are composed and finished, with no z-fighting, holes, floating props or placeholder blocks seen. Remaining defects are framing and cosmetic. 1000006: the Dangerous Forest is placed camera-side of it (layout.py line 121: 'behind the Dangerous Forest'), so about 30% of the lower frame is 1000002's dark turf and pines, and a dark broadleaf tree covers the arrival portal at about (770,550) px. 1000005: the jump-tower spire renders as a grey, horizontally banded cylinder that reads as a silo. 40001: the tan road ribbon at the bottom left ends square at a cliff edge at about (690,950) px. 1000001: flowers grow out of the planks of the timber stair at the top right (about (1730-1790,145-185) px). 40000: the left knoll flight reads as three separate slabs laid over the tier rims. 1000002: the darker spur tint overlaps the main trail edge at about (1550-1870,480-800) px. render.py has no foreground exclusion of other map collections in Gameplay renders, so neighbour occlusion is possible elsewhere too, but I saw it only in 1000006.

issues.issue: The Gameplay frame is partly occluded by the neighbouring Dangerous Forest. layout.py line 121 places 1000006 behind 1000002, so 1000002's dark turf, dark pines, a dead snag and a broadleaf tree fill the lower-centre and lower-right of the frame, about (760-1920, 600-1080) px. One dark tree at about (800-1040, 410-840) px hides most of the arrival portal at the hub lip (about (770,550) px). The hub then sits in the lower half and 1000002's foreground falls out of frame. Move m.player (now (20.6, 3.0), v about 0.51) to a hub point nearer the new focus, e.g. (19, 4.5), so it stays inside 0.1-0.9, then re-run player_in_gameplay_frame. Alternative, shared: in render.py, for CAM_<slug>_Gameplay, set hide_render on other maps' Props/Trees collections whose footprint lies camera-side of the subject's front edge, and restore them after the render.

issues.issue: Short ropes read as crooked sticks or stakes rather than ropes at gameplay scale (32-44). The strand is r 0.07, only 4-5 px on screen, and the mapkit rope builder drapes it over the lip onto the cap, which draws a hook or crook at the top. This matters most in 40001, which per its research note is built entirely from ropes; there they read like walking sticks at about (460,490), (265,600), (905,935) and (1615,975) px. It is also visible on 40000's east-meadow ropes (about x 1410/1530 px), 40002's three chimney ropes and 1000006 (about (375,280) px). Longer ropes with a foot ring (1000005, 1000001) read fine. Ladders and vines are unaffected.
issues.fix: In mapkit's rope builder (the over-the-lip section, around lines 615-640), replace the bare drape with a visible tie-off. Add a short wooden peg or stake (about r 0.06, 0.35 m tall) on the cap 0.3 m behind the lip, and end the strand in a small knot torus around it, so the top reads as anchored, not hooked. Give the strand a lighter hemp tint than the soil faces, with darker knot bands every 0.35-0.4 m (thin torus rings), so it separates from the brown cliff. Optionally raise the visual radius to about 0.085 while keeping the clearance checks at 0.07. Rebuild and re-run floating_props and props_near_routes.

criteria.name: (1) Trails meet maps cleanly at portals (no z-fight stripes, pale rectangles or floating aprons at trail ends)
criteria.evidence: I checked every visible trail end across the 7 region frames and saw no stripes, pale rectangles or raised aprons at region scale. Ends checked: 0/10000/20000/30000 in Region_MushroomTownArea; 40000->40001 (~690,415 / 750,480) and 40001->40002 (~990,725 / 1090,800) in Region_SnailHuntingGrounds; the 1000000 in00/in01/in04/in05 portals (~690,610; 1175,670; 1260,675; 1255,580) in Region_WestAmherstForests; Amherst east00 -> 1020000 (~1025,635 -> 1135,705) and 1010002 west00 (~820,375) in Region_AmherstArea; 50000 east01 -> Southperry NW portal (~880,580) in Region_SouthperryAndSplitRoad. All join the in-map paths without a seam. Caveat: hairline z-fighting may not show in a downscaled region PNG, so this pass relies on validation too: trail_walk passes 20/20 in VALIDATION.md.

criteria.name: (2) Trails read as deliberate paths/stairs with sensible slopes, curving where long
criteria.evidence: The 30000->40000 and 40002->50000 stone flights read as deliberate stairs with cheeks (Region_SnailHuntingGrounds top-left and bottom-right; Region_SouthperryAndSplitRoad top-left). The 10000->20000 lane curves, with fences and lamps (Region_MushroomTownArea ~880-1060, 470-620). The 37.5 m 50000->60000 lane curves down to Southperry (Region_SouthperryAndSplitRoad ~830-1100, 450-600). The 1010004 lane bends onto its rim road. The 1000005 trail is now 10.6 m, so the old three-tooth 'circuit-board' comb is gone, and the 1000004 trail is a short fenced lane under Amherst's plinth. Residual: the longest trail, 1000000 in05 -> 1000006 (61 m; build_report says curved:true), shows no visible bend at region scale. It reads as a straight sandy gully lane (Region_WestAmherstForests ~1240,650 -> 1150,330; Region_RainbowStreet x~540, y 320-520) running parallel to the 1010004 lane (x~1030), which leaves a mild two-strip comb. It still reads as a valley lane rather than a runway, so the criterion passes with a medium issue filed.

criteria.name: (3) Neighbouring maps read as one island with consistent palette/scale; each region has its own character
criteria.evidence:
All regions share one bright-green toon palette, the same ink outlines, the same terrace/plinth language and consistent house-to-tree scale. Each region's character:
- NW Mushroom Town: an open meadow pocket with giant red/blue/orange toadstools on the skirts, sparse big oaks and peaks behind (Region_MushroomTownArea). It reads as a village, not farmsteads in a forest.
- Port: Southperry's white and blue domes, palms, lighthouse and overhanging ship are clearly distinct (Region_SouthperryAndSplitRoad).
- Amherst: the cobble plaza, rainbow sign and mushroom houses read strongly (Region_AmherstArea).
- Rainbow Street gardens: 1000003's colourful mushroom beds and the 1010004 flower terraces are distinct.
- Dangerous Forest (1000002): darker, with dark pines and red/teal canopy (Region_WestAmherstForests right-centre).
Blurs: the autumn orange/yellow palette also covers the Snail Hunting Grounds and 1020000, so the 'autumn birch valley' is not unique to one region. 1000002 reads dark only through its canopy; its floor stays the same bright green.

criteria.name: (4) No obviously floating or intersecting scenery
criteria.evidence: No floating trees, rocks or props were seen in any of the 7 frames. Boulders, toadstools, palms and filler trees all sit on the ground with matching shadows. Southperry's ship overhangs the hull edge on purpose, with cloud puffs under the keel. The lower waterfall sheet now ends at the lake's north shore with a foam puff (Region_MapleRoad and Region_SnailHuntingGrounds). One minor contact: a blue scatter toadstool sits on a grey boulder at the left of Region_MushroomTownArea (~65-120, 440-510).

criteria.name: (5) The 1000006 plank-bridge arrival and the 1010004 arrival read sensibly in Region_WestAmherstForests / Region_AmherstArea
criteria.evidence:
Split result.
- 1010004 passes. In Region_AmherstArea the trail climbs north along 1010004's east flank from the 1010002 west portal (~820,375). It curves at (~790,85) onto the fenced top rim road along the road's axis, with no 90-degree corner and no grass flank between trail and road.
- 1000006 does not. In Region_WestAmherstForests, at the trail's top (~1150-1190, 290-345), I see no plank span, no rope rails and no void under the hub lip. The sandy lane appears to run straight into the golden dell's lower-left corner. That is the original triage complaint ('the floating arrival hub reads as the end of a ridge'), so the intent of fix #13b (BRIDGE_END 8 m of planks on rope rails over air) is not visible from the designated camera. build_report does record bridge_m: 8, so the geometry may exist but lack contrast. The dell itself reads and nothing looks broken, so this is not high.

issues.issue: The 1000006 plank-bridge arrival does not read as a bridge in Region_WestAmherstForests. At the trail's top (~1150-1190, 290-345) there is no visible plank span, rope rails or air gap under the hub lip; the lane seems to run straight into the dell's lower-left corner, as in iter2 ('reads as the end of a ridge'). build_report records bridge_m: 8, so the span may exist but lack contrast or be hidden.
issues.fix: First check the 1000006 Gameplay and Overview renders. If an 8 m rope-rail span over air exists, raise its contrast: dark-stained planks, taller rail posts (~1.1 m) in a contrasting colour, a lantern or Sign_Arrow post at each end, and a dark void under the hub lip (pull the hub's front skirt further back or darken the under-bridge cliff). If there is no span, the causeway still fills the gap: fix the BRIDGE_END handling in trails.build_trail so the causeway solid and flanks stop 8 m short and only planks on rails cross. Re-render Region_WestAmherstForests.

issues.issue: The longest trail, 1000000 in05 -> 1000006 (61 m against the triage's 40-45 m target), still reads as a straight sandy gully lane at region scale despite curved:true in build_report. See Region_WestAmherstForests (~1240,650 -> 1150,330) and Region_RainbowStreet (x~540). Next to the parallel 1010004 lane (x~1030) it leaves a mild two-strip comb.
issues.fix: In layout.LINKS, shorten the 1000006 link toward ~45 m on a bearing that still clears 1000002/1000005. Or, in trails.build_trail, raise the lateral Catmull-Rom waypoint offset for mid-sections over 40 m from 6-12 m to 12-18 m so a visible S-bend forms. Plant 2-3 tree/shrub clumps on the inside of each bend to break the sightline.

issues.issue: The waterfall crescent cliff still reads as two stacked, flat-faced grey boxes at the visual centre of Region_MapleRoad (~1150-1430, 300-470) and the top of Region_SnailHuntingGrounds (~1030-1530, 0-250).
